note: The sheet of the fixture rheometer request. The instrument does not exist; its figures are the specification section of meta_agent/tests/fixtures/rheometer/README.md, and tool_ref names the registry's lab_rheometer because the fixture stands in for it until its model is known (plan.md 14-21), which is also what the bound skills name. No row's value is chosen here: an interval is what the skills give, and the point inside it is tasks/011's.
